name: Slice-by-Slice Backprojection
definition: A backprojection reorganization into a single sweep through the volume, processing slice-by-slice, used for cloud-like volumes with parallel light rays.
summary: Slice-by-Slice Backprojection efficiently renders cloud-like volumes under parallel light by reorganizing the backprojection integral into a single sweep that processes the volume one horizontal slice at a time.
